meta_description: Fareham Electrician provides reliable domestic and commercial electrical services across Southampton. Fast response, fully qualified. Call 07962 983556 today.
hero_subhead: Faulty wiring, broken sockets, or urgent electrical faults in Southampton? We're here fast — same-day response for emergencies.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and rewires to installations and safety inspections, we handle all domestic and commercial electrical work.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped electrics, or dead circuits? We diagnose and fix faults fast, any time of day. Most repairs completed same visit.

services.title: Rewires & Full House Upgrades
services.desc: Old wiring causing problems? We install modern, safe electrics to current Building Regulations, with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Socket & Switch Installation
services.desc: New sockets, USB outlets, dimmer switches, and smart home wiring. We position them where you need them and finish neatly.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Installation
services.desc: Safe, efficient boiler and central heating setup by fully qualified engineers. We handle the electrics alongside your heating engineer.

services.title: Periodic Electrical Testing
services.desc: EICR (electrical condition report) and safety inspections for landlords, tenants, and homebuyers. Detailed report and remedial advice included.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work
services.desc: Businesses across Southampton trust us for shop rewires, office lighting upgrades, and fault-finding. Fast turnaround, minimal downtime.

about_pullquote: We answer the phone and get there quickly — no hidden charges, no nonsense.
about_para_1: Fareham Electrician has been serving Southampton and the surrounding areas for 18 years. We started as a one-man operation and have grown by word-of-mouth because we show up on time, do the job right, and charge fairly. Every electrician on our team is NICEIC qualified and insured — your safety is our priority.
about_para_2: We're local, we're reliable, and we keep our prices honest. Whether you need an emergency callout at midnight or a planned rewire, you'll get a straight answer and no surprise bills. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and their referrals — that tells you everything.

reviews.text: Called at 11pm on a Saturday with a complete power loss. He was here by midnight and had the problem sorted within an hour. Professional, friendly, and didn't overcharge. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Rewired our 1960s bungalow. The work was excellent, he explained everything clearly, and finished on schedule. We felt completely confident leaving him to it. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Catherine P.

reviews.text: Came out for a landlord's inspection, found a couple of faults, and quoted us fairly to fix them. No pressure, just honest advice. That's rare these days. Top bloke.
reviews.author: David M.

address_sub: Serving Southampton, Fareham, Park Gate, Whiteley, and surrounding areas
